notes: Galeries Lafayette Maison (SR145, France). Access: curl_cffi TLS-impersonation (safari17_0) reaches www.galerieslafayette.com and sapapi.galerieslafayette.com after a homepage warm-up GET for the __cf_bm/cf_clearance cookies; robots.txt has no Claude/anthropic-specific Disallow (only User-agent:* plus Pinterestbot/Twitterbot/SemrushBot/AhrefsBot groups), so proceeded. Checked for a Bestsellers-type PLP across all discovery channels: (1) full site sitemap.xml -> siteMap/Trend-fr-EUR.xml, the sitemap of all 29 cross-department 'trend' landing pages (the site's merchandising-PLP mechanism, URL shape /t/<id>, backed by occ/v2/gl-fr/catalogs/gl-frProductCatalog/Main/trends/<id>) -- none of the 29 (outlet, cadeaux-de-naissance, soldes, petits-prix, go-for-good, nouveautes, lingerie-menstruelle, semaine-de-la-fidelite, fete-des-meres, cadeaux-de-mariage, cadeaux-pour-lui/elle/enfant, cadeaux-cremaillere, cadeaux-d-exception, bons-plans, idees-cadeaux, hermessence, ceremonie, nos-offres-privees, french-touch, cosmetique-coreen, cadeaux-sacs-et-accessoires, cadeaux-montres-et-bijoux, cadeaux-jeux-et-jouets, idees-cadeaux-noel, idees-cadeaux-saint-valentin, nouvelles-collections, tenues-de-mariage) is a bestseller/popularity concept. (2) Direct probes of the trends/<id> API for plausible bestseller slugs -- meilleures-ventes, best-sellers, bestsellers, top-ventes, favoris, coups-de-coeur, tendances -- all returned HTTP 400 (page id does not exist), vs. 200 for genuine pages (soldes, outlet, nouveautes, nouvelles-collections, petits-prix, derniere-chance). (3) Searched the full Angular app JS bundle (main.*.js, ~5MB, all French i18n strings) for 'meilleures ventes' / 'best seller' / 'top vente' -- zero matches anywhere in the translation tables. (4) Category-fr-EUR.xml sitemap (526 URLs under the Maison department tree) also has no bestseller-named node. (5) TIER-3 CONFIRMATION (Claude-in-Chrome, run after coordinator follow-up): loaded the live site's own search for the query 'meilleures ventes' at /search/meilleures+ventes -- it returned a generic non-discriminating product mix (beauty items, cookware, tableware) with no bestseller framing/heading/facet, i.e. the same query-is-ignored fallback behavior already confirmed via the OCC API for every query tested. This is the exact 'zero-result / default-result site search is not proof of absence' failure mode the brief warns about, so it was NOT used as the basis for the absence conclusion -- it only reconfirms that the sitemap + API-probe + JS-bundle evidence (which are unaffected by the broken search/query layer) are the reliable signals here. Conclusion: Galeries Lafayette (site-wide, and therefore also within Maison) has no genuine Bestsellers/Best-Sellers/Meilleures-ventes merchandising PLP. This is a real absence, not a search-tool false negative -- confirmed via sitemap enumeration + direct API existence probes + full JS-bundle string search + a live Claude-in-Chrome search check, not via site search alone.
